支持与测试

Chordesk 当前在同一局域网内连接 iPhone 和 Mac。本轮以 Duo 为主要测试设备；公网与非 Duo 测试尚未完成。

开始连接

  1. 安装 Mac 0.18.1 试用版，需要 Apple Silicon 与 macOS 15.2 或更新版本。测试包尚未公证，请先阅读 安装说明。
  2. 点击 Mac 主机的“开始服务”，按引导开启录屏与控制权限。检查完成后应用会重启一次。
  3. 手机和 Mac 连接同一局域网，在 Chordesk 中扫描主机二维码。之后可从已配对列表重连；Mac IP 变化时重新扫码。

操作指南

App 菜单包含“Duo 操作手册”。也可阅读 完整说明或观看 真机演示。背面一指配合正面双指控制窗口与桌面；背面双指长按临时切换触控板。左右切桌面还需要 Mac 的 System Events 自动化授权与系统快捷键。

常见问题

连接失败：确认主机服务运行、设备在同一网络且 IP 未变化。权限失败：按 Mac 主机设置中的检查结果重新授权。机器真正睡眠时不保证能连接；接通电源保持系统运行、显示器定时息屏是不同的设置。

背面无响应：先抬起全部手指，确认有效区域、前台与相机权限；仍异常时在菜单关闭再开启背面操作，并记录诊断信息。长时间闲置后的恢复是本轮重点测试项。

反馈

通过 TestFlight 发送反馈，或在 GitHub Issues报告设备／系统版本、App 版本、手势组合与实际表现。公开反馈请勿包含私人内容与有效配对凭据。

iOS 正式发行包正在准备 TestFlight，尚无公开邀请链接。查看隐私政策。

Support & testing

Chordesk currently connects an iPhone and Mac on the same local network. This beta focuses on Duo; Internet access and non-Duo testing are not complete.

Connect

  1. Install the Mac 0.18.1 test host on Apple Silicon with macOS 15.2 or later. The test package is not notarized; read the installation guide.
  2. Click Start service (开始服务) and complete screen-recording and control permissions. The app restarts once after its permission checks.
  3. Connect both devices to the same LAN and scan the host QR code in Chordesk. Reconnect later from the saved list. Scan again if the Mac’s IP address changes.

Gestures

The app menu includes the complete Duo operation manual. See the written guide (Chinese) or real-device video. Hold one rear finger and swipe two front fingers for windows and Spaces; hold two rear fingers for a temporary front trackpad. Spaces switching also requires System Events automation authorization and the corresponding macOS shortcuts.

Troubleshooting

If connection fails, check that the host is running, both devices are on the same network, and the Mac IP has not changed. For permissions, follow the host Settings checks. Actual system sleep may make the Mac unreachable; keeping the system awake on power while allowing the display to turn off is a separate setting.

If rear input stops responding, lift all fingers and check the activation region, foreground state, and camera permission. If needed, toggle rear interaction off and on and record diagnostics. Recovery after prolonged idle time remains a focus of this beta.

Feedback

Use TestFlight feedback or GitHub Issues. Include device/OS and app versions, the gesture combination, and what happened. Do not post private content or valid pairing credentials publicly.

The iOS distribution build is being prepared for TestFlight; no public invitation is available yet. Privacy policy.
